title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on Exodus 25: the offering for the sanctuary and the ark, the mercy seat, the table and the lamp stand.

questions.text: From whom was Moses to take the offering for Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The offering was to be taken from everyone whose heart made him willing.

answers.text: Only from the elders of the tribes
From every firstborn son in Israel
Only from the men of the tribe of Levi
From everyone whose heart made him willing

questions.text: Why were the people to make a sanctuary?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: "Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them."

answers.text: So that the nations would fear Israel
So that God might dwell among them
So that the priests had a place to live
So that the tablets could be hidden from the people

questions.text: What kind of wood was the ark to be made of?
questions.explanation: They were to make an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long.

questions.text: Where were the four gold rings of the ark to be put?
questions.explanation: Four rings of gold were to be cast and put in its four feet, two on each side.

answers.text: On the corners of the mercy seat

questions.text: What rule applied to the poles of the ark?
questions.explanation: The poles were to stay in the rings of the ark; they were not to be taken from it.

answers.text: They were to be taken out whenever the ark stood still
They were never to be taken out of the rings
They were to be made of bronze
They were to be covered with a blue cloth

questions.text: Which way were the faces of the two cherubim to be turned?
questions.explanation: The cherubim were to face one another, with their faces toward the mercy seat.

answers.text: Outward, toward the people in the camp
One to the east and one to the west
Toward one another, toward the mercy seat

questions.text: From where did God say he would speak with Moses?
questions.explanation: God would meet with Moses and speak from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim on the ark.

answers.text: From the top of the lamp stand
From beside the table of bread
From the horns of the bronze altar

questions.text: What was always to be set on the table before God?
questions.explanation: Bread of the presence was to be set on the table before God always.

questions.text: The cups on the branches of the lamp stand were to look like what?
questions.explanation: Each branch had three cups made like almond blossoms, with a bud and a flower.

questions.text: How much pure gold was the lamp stand with all its accessories to be made of?
questions.explanation: The lamp stand was to be made of a talent of pure gold, with all its accessories.
